title: Two-tape table reader
statement: For a natural number $n$, the table reader takes a bit string and attempts to parse the encoded actions for all $n+1$ states and all combinations of the possibly blank input symbol and the two possibly blank work-tape symbols. On success it returns the resulting two-tape code table together with the unconsumed suffix; on failure it returns no result.
caveat: The supplied statement omits the definitions of the action, symbol, and vector readers, so the exact parsing conventions are unavailable.
